definitions: The action of dishonestly appropriating (money or goods entrusted to one's care) for one's own use.
The act of diverting funds illegally or improperly to one's own use.
examples: He was accused of embezzling funds from the company.
The ongoing investigation into her embezzling activities.
The bank manager was caught embezzling millions.
pastTenses: embezzled (past simple), embezzled (present perfect), embezzled (past perfect)
